cards.card_text: Then the passage says, 'I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, a dirge over the wilderness pasture…' Friend, when the MOUNTAINS get their own sad song, you know something has gone real wrong out there.
cards.verse_text: I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, a dirge over the wilderness pasture, for they have been scorched so no one passes through, and the lowing of cattle is not heard.
cards.snippet: I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, a dirge over the wilderness pasture, for they have been scorched so no one…

cards.card_text: The children call out, "We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn." Friend, that's me baking chocolate chip, then sprinkles, then butterscotch, and the SAME guy won't touch ANY of it, so at some point...
cards.verse_text: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
cards.snippet: …the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’

cards.card_text: Jesus says they're like children sitting in the marketplace, calling out to one another about the flute they played and the dirge they sang.
cards.verse_text: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to one another: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.’
cards.snippet: …the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.’

cards.card_text: In Jesus' picture, the children played the flute and sang a dirge for the others.
